children.heading: In general
children.text: The term “3D elevation data” means 3D, high-resolution data obtained using LiDAR, IfSAR, or other methods over the United States (including territories).

children.heading: Inclusions
children.text: The term “3D elevation data” includes terrestrial and bathymetric elevation data.

tree.heading: 3D elevation program
tree.text: The term “3D Elevation Program” means the 3D Elevation Program established under section 3104(a) of this title.

tree.heading: IfSAR
tree.text: The term “IfSAR” means interferometric synthetic aperture radar.

tree.heading: Indian tribe
tree.text: The term “Indian tribe” has the meaning given the term in section 5304 of title 25.

tree.heading: Lahar
tree.text: The term “lahar” means a large debris flow of mostly volcanic material that is—

children.text: a hazard in watersheds downstream of volcanic peaks.

tree.heading: LiDAR
tree.text: The term “LiDAR” means light detection and ranging.

tree.heading: Secretary
tree.text: The term “Secretary” means the Secretary of the Interior, acting through the Director of the United States Geological Survey.

tree.heading: State office
tree.text: The term “State office” means any unit of State government that handles the identification, mapping, assessment, and research of landslide hazards or responding to landslide events, including—

children.text: a State department of emergency response; and
the Commonwealth of the Northern Mariana Islands;
the Republic of the Marshall Islands;

notes.heading: Short Title
notes.text: Pub. L. 116–323, § 1, Jan. 5, 2021, 134 Stat. 5075, provided that: “This Act [enacting this chapter] may be cited as the ‘National Landslide Preparedness Act’.”
